page.overview:
Who is Theo?

Theo is a minor character in Invincible, debuting on Season 2. He is the widower of Green Ghost II.

Theo is a tall man with a medium to dark complexion and a lean build. He has short dark hair and defined features that give him a composed look.

He wears a gray jacket over a white collared shirt, paired with beige pants and brown shoes.

Before his wife's murder, he was a devoted man who cherished his wife above everyone and everything. Nonetheless, following her murder, he fell into a deep depression and found it impossible to advance in his life. He loathed Omni-Man for murdering his wife and also blamed Debbie for not revealing the truth about him earlier.
